compute_mAP: compute mean average precision from a submission array and ground truth array
compute_nanmap: compute mean average precision ignoring NaN values from submission and ground truth arrays
run_charades_map: run the Charades evaluation function to compute mAP for action recognition predictions
run_charades_nanmap: run the Charades evaluation function with NaN handling for action recognition predictions
refactor_mAP: refactor the mAP function to support additional metrics like recall or F1 score
